methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $6M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Albacore is a seed-stage ocean and maritime technology company founded by John Huddleston and Dante Vaisbort. The company has raised $6.5M to date. The valuation comp universe consists of three private peers in the ocean and maritime sector—Standard Subsea, Clippership, and NetworkOcean—with no established public comparables available.

Given the early-stage nature and limited public market precedent, stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised of $6M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, the analysis yields an implied valuation of $16M. This serves as the median point in the derived range.

The triangulated valuation range is $14M (low) to $19M (median-anchored), with a central estimate of $16M. The relatively narrow spread reflects reliance on a single methodology. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this sector, limited visibility into private peer valuations and transaction multiples, and absence of public market anchors to validate pricing assumptions. Additional diligence on the private comp set and management's near-term funding expectations would help narrow the range.
